questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.

Zara is buying a new car.

options.text: A new car has been bought by Zara.
A new car was bought by Zara.
A new car is bought by Zara.
A new car is being bought by Zara.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence needs to be converted from **active to passive voice.**
 
• In passive voice, the object of **the active sentence (a new car) becomes the subject.**
 
• The correct tense must be maintained; here,** "is buying" (present continuous) becomes "is being bought".**
 
• The doer of the action **(Zara) **is mentioned at the end of the sentence preceded by** "by".**
 
• Thus, the correct passive construction is **"A new car is being bought by Zara."**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence: *"A new car is being bought by Zara."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "A new car has been bought by Zara."** – Incorrect tense; "has been bought" is present perfect, not present continuous.
 
• **Option 2: "A new car was bought by Zara."** – Incorrect tense; "was bought" is past simple, not present continuous.
 
• **Option 3: "A new car is bought by Zara."** – Incorrect tense; "is bought" is present simple, not present continuous.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

He said to me, 'I am grateful to you.'

options.text: He told me he is grateful to me.
He said that I am grateful to you.
He says to me that he is grateful to me.
He told me that he was grateful to me.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is** the conversion of direct speech to reported speech.**
 
• When converting direct speech to reported speech,** the present tense verb "am" changes to the past tense "was."**
 
• The pronouns also need to be adjusted accordingly;** "I" becomes "he" and "you" becomes "me."**
 
• Thus, the correct reported speech form of the sentence is **"He told me that he was grateful to me."**__

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
